internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Drexel Technologies’ main location in Lenexa, Kansas, boasts a dedicated and highly skilled team that has served the Kansas City area for over 75 years. It is from Lenexa that our leadership guides our company through mentoring our employees. Communication, creativity, relationship building, and problem-solving are all characteristics of our team.
Opening in 2005 and moving to a new location in 2015, our downtown location in Kansas City, MO has given us the flexibility needed to deliver on-time projects to even more of our customers.
